seo.description: Visit Kasbah Tifoultoute near Ouarzazate: hilltop kasbah with wide views — quieter than Taourirt.

name: Kasbah Tifoultoute
hero_subtitle: Kasbah en lo alto cerca de la ciudad — vistas amplias y ritmo más tranquilo.

overview.title: A quieter kasbah on the rise
overview.p1: Kasbah Tifoultoute sits on a rise outside Ouarzazate with broad views. Less crowded than Taourirt or Aït Benhaddou for many visitors.
overview.p2: Go for the setting and silhouette more than museum-style exhibits.

1.title: Clear air
1.desc: Good chance of open horizons before heat haze builds.

2.title: Bright exposure
2.desc: Strong sun on the hill; limit time if very hot.

3.title: Silhouette hour
3.desc: The kasbah profile works well as light drops.

food.title: Eat near Tifoultoute
food.p1: Limited on-site dining. Plan meals in Ouarzazate.
food.p2: About the setting, not the food scene.
food.li2: Do not rely on a full restaurant.
food.li3: Eat in town before or after.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Petit taxi or private driver; agree a round-trip price.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Fits an afternoon after Studios or Taourirt.

q1.question: How far from town?
q1.answer: A short drive west of Ouarzazate.

q2.question: Better than Taourirt?
q2.answer: Different — calmer hill stop versus the major town kasbah.

q3.question: Need a long visit?
q3.answer: No — forty-five to ninety minutes suits most.

q4.question: Family friendly?
q4.answer: Yes with care on uneven ground.
